    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    divider_row = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0), None)
    if divider_row is not None:
        top, bottom = grid[:divider_row], grid[divider_row + 1:]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                for ra, rb in zip(top, bottom)]
    divider_col = next((c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != 0), None)
    if divider_col is not None:
        left = [row[:divider_col] for row in grid]
        right = [row[divider_col + 1:] for row in grid]
        return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
